content:
Anna (Support): Customer reported billing portal failures after switching to structured JSON mode for invoices. They see a JSON parse error and invoices not rendering. customer_id=87231
Jorge (Oncall): can you paste the failing response or a curl? I can tail logs. :eyes:
Anna (Support): repro from customer environment attached, trying to reproduce locally, here's the curl they used:
```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\  
  -d '{"customer_id":87231, "include_items":true}' \\  
  https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/invoices/generate?mode=structured
```
Anna (Support): response they get is failing JSON parse in our frontend: "Unexpected token ‘:’ in JSON at position 123"
Sam (Eng): paste the raw body exactly as returned (not through browser). parsing errors usually mean we returned malformed JSON or mixed types.
Anna (Support): raw body from them (copied):
```json
{"invoice_id":"100482","customer_id":87231,"total":123.45,"paid":null,"currency":"Usd","items":[{"desc":"usage","qty":10}]}
```
Sam (Eng): aha — invoice_id is a string, schema expects number. paid is null (schema boolean) and currency casing is wrong (should be "USD"). Those type/coercion changes will blow up strict parsers.
Jorge (Oncall): I see a deploy log at 2026-11-03T02:00:12Z that updated invoice serializer to "normalize": true. That change might be incorrectly stringifying IDs for some code paths. Rolling back for now?
Lina (PM): customer's billing UI is down; advise rollback fast. If rollback not possible, we can disable structured mode for invoices as temporary mitigation and surface a plain JSON response.
Sam (Eng): trying a local repro against staging... reproducing the stringified id when item count > 0. Looks like a change in fmt.InvoiceID -> toString in serializer.
InvoiceBot: [schema-regression] Detected new schema variant for endpoint /v1/invoices/generate in prod at 2026-11-03T02:00:12Z. Affected fields: invoice_id (string vs number), paid (null vs boolean), currency (case mismatch).
Jorge (Oncall): rolling back commit cb3f9a8 now. ETA ~2m.
Anna (Support): I messaged the customer asking for a short window and offered disabling structured mode as workaround. They agreed.
Sam (Eng): rollback completed at 1901234580. Confirming service restart and no more stringified ids in responses.
Jorge (Oncall): tailing logs — post-rollback responses look clean. Example returned body now:
```json
{"invoice_id":100482,"customer_id":87231,"total":123.45,"paid":false,"currency":"USD","items":[{"desc":"usage","qty":10}]}
```
Lina (PM): great. Anna, please confirm customer can refresh and that their UI parses fine. Also include apology + mitigation notes.
Anna (Support): customer confirmed UI back to normal, parsing fixed. Sent follow-up: "we rolled back a serializer change that caused strict JSON parsers to fail; we'll follow up with a permanent fix and postmortem." :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): root cause: serializer change introduced to normalize IDs for external exports but accidentally applied to internal structured responses. Will add schema validation in CI + a feature flag gating serializer.
Jorge (Oncall): created incident PRD-2026-11-03 and flagged for postmortem.
Lina (PM): please add a customer-impact field in the postmortem and link their case ref 2026-87231.
Anna (Support): added case ref. Closing thread once postmortem draft is ready.
Sam (Eng): will open a changelist to add strict typing tests and an integration test against the invoice JSON schema.
Jorge (Oncall): FYI if anyone needs to find logs: logs/prod/invoice-service/2026-11-03/02:00*.gz
Anna (Support): thanks everyone. Closing for now.
